findings.issue: The review reducer leaves visits out of the frontier count when they failed (FRONTIER_FAILED_STATUSES, line 33, applied in reviewFrontierVisits at line 1955 and in buildReviewFrontier's covered-dimension filter). No review test checks this. Every frontier fixture in deep-review-state-reducer.vitest.ts uses completed records. The only error record in that file (line 385) is not attributed to any frontier node. If the filter were deleted, an errored or timed-out iteration would count against the depth band's budget and could close an open node as exhausted/budget. Its dimensions could also derive the node as answered, and the review suite would stay green. The research twin does test this (deep-research-reduce-state.vitest.ts:2265, 'does not count a failed attempt as a visit when ranking open nodes'). Case: an expansive review whose state log holds {status:'error', frontierNodeId:'F-1-001', dimensions:[...]}. This is an untested edge branch of tested behavior, so it is P2 under test-quality-checklist.md section 2 (line 62). Fix: add a review-reducer case where an errored record for a node adds nothing to visits, budget spent or coveredDimensions.

evidence.out: Only deep-review-state-reducer.vitest.ts matches, and its single error record (line 385) is {type:'iteration', iteration:2, status:'error', focus:'dim-2'} in the non-frontier test 'shows a landed iteration as error when the still-fails row follows it'.

findings.issue: review.maintainability (repeated logic that behaves differently). The review and research reducers each hold their own copy of the frontier projection: the 50/35/15 band budget, the roll-down, FRONTIER_STATUSES, FRONTIER_FAILED_STATUSES and the node-marker regex. The copies are review applyReviewFrontierBudget (line 1965) and research applyFrontierBudget (deep-research/scripts/reduce-state.cjs:2524). They have already drifted where the dashboards show the same labels. (1) 'Revisits' is visits minus covered dimensions on the review dashboard (runtime reduce-state.cjs:2538) but visits minus 1 on the research dashboard (deep-research reduce-state.cjs:3131). (2) The review 'Frontier size' line (2546) leaves out the abstained count that the research line (3129) shows. (3) Only research stamps closedAtIteration on a budget close (2553). (4) Research attributes visits by the focus marker only (frontierNodeVisitRecords, 2488). Review also uses frontierNodeId and the store's active rows (reviewRecordsForNode, 1936). A change to the budget split defaults or to the failed-status vocabulary has to be made twice, and an operator reading the two dashboards gets 'Revisits' numbers that mean different things. Case: the same frontier store with one node visited twice and covering 2 dimensions shows Revisits 0 on review and Revisits 1 on research. Fix: move the band budget and status vocabulary into one shared runtime module, and either align the Revisits definition or label each one by what it counts.
